findings.pdf_says: Format 2 (into-giving) and Format 4 (into-remainder) print on one baseline: DIVIDE { identifier-1 / literal-1 } INTO { identifier-2 / literal-2 }, each brace two lines tall with INTO between the closing brace of the first and the opening brace of the second.
findings.why_it_matters: In both Format 2 and Format 4 the drawn figure is distorted: the identifier-1/literal-1 brace is stretched to five lines with an empty top, the keyword INTO is lifted to a line of its own above the second brace instead of sitting between the two braces on the DIVIDE baseline, and the second brace's middle line is attached to DIVIDE's row. The token order is recoverable (DIVIDE, first brace, INTO, second brace), so no syntax is lost, but the figure no longer reads as the printed general format and should be redrawn like Format 3 on the same page.
